summary: Healthy Choice Wellness Corp. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $17.5 million underwritten public offering of Class A common stock on the NYSE American, with a 30-day option for underwriters to buy up to an additional $2.6 million of shares. Pricing, share count and discount are left blank in this preliminary filing; the last reported sale price was $11.33 on September 17, 2026. Cantor is lead book-running manager with Siebert, A.G.P. and Clear Street. The ticker is expected to change to HOST on September 18, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing, dilution and use of proceeds.
